correctness.rationale: H_p X H_q is the orthogonal projection of the complete-bipartite edge cube to the cycle space. A sign matrix has projected squared norm pq - sum(row²)/q - sum(col²)/p + total²/(pq); completing row or column means gives nonnegative variance. Odd p forces at least q/p deficit and odd q at least p/q; even/even has zero deficit. Explicit checkerboard, opposite-column and odd cyclic-shift constructions attain the max of the parity deficits. Equality conditions force all unit minimal-parity sums and opposite equal sums. Strict convexity excludes nonvertices from outer contacts; opposite outer contacts are all diametral pairs and force unique sphere center zero. Independent exhaustive sign checks for six profiles up to 4×4 matched radii and every equality criterion. No assertion for weights or other Gale metrics.
